resolution_notes: base_url: replace; AFP's current official news site serves media from this host (https://us.afpnews.com/). docs_url: replace the 404 legacy path with AFP's maintained API page describing endpoint documentation, a quick-start guide and Swagger access (https://www.afp.com/en/our-offer/afp-api). example: replace the invented Bearer /v1/search call; AFP says credentials are issued after registration, so the curl conservatively uses the contract-issued search URL and authentication header (https://www.afp.com/en/our-offer/afp-api).
